# Your Safe Space – Psychologische Beratung (Silvia Soret, Zürich)

> Psychological counselling for adults and couples in Zurich's old town (Altstadt) or online by video, with Silvia Soret. Sessions in Swiss German, German, English and French. / Psychologische Beratung für Erwachsene und Paare in der Zürcher Altstadt oder online, auf Schweizerdeutsch, Deutsch, Englisch und Französisch. / Conseil psychologique pour adultes et couples dans la vieille ville de Zurich ou en ligne, en français, allemand, suisse allemand et anglais.

## Key facts

- Counsellor: Silvia Soret. In training as a body-centred psychological counsellor (Körperzentrierte psychologische Beraterin IKP, IKP Institut für Körperzentrierte Psychotherapie, Zürich, 2024–2027). Works according to the ethical principles of the Swiss Society for Counselling (SGfB).
- Address: Stüssihofstatt 7, 8001 Zürich, Switzerland. A small room in the rear courtyard of a listed guild building from 1357. Step-free access is not guaranteed.
- Formats: in person in Zurich, or online by video.
- Languages: Swiss German, German, English, French.
- Services:
  - Individual counselling for adults: burnout and stress, anxiety and inner restlessness, life orientation and crises of meaning, recurring personal patterns, trauma and early experiences, lack of drive and inner emptiness, feeling overwhelmed by everyday life.
  - Couples counselling.
  - Relationship counselling (partnership, friendships, family, work).
  - Support for couples after the birth of a child.
- Fees: individual CHF 180 per 60 minutes (CHF 15 per additional 5 minutes); couples CHF 220 per 60 minutes (CHF 18.33 per additional 5 minutes).
- Payment: invoice by e-mail, payable within 30 days by bank transfer.
- Cancellation: at least 2 working days (48 hours) in advance; later cancellations or no-shows are charged in full.
- Health insurance: psychological counselling is generally not covered by Swiss health insurers. Clients pay themselves.
- Confidentiality: bound by professional confidentiality; data handled under Swiss data protection law.
- Contact: WhatsApp +41 78 321 61 04 (WhatsApp only), e-mail silvia@yoursafespace.ch, or the contact form. Replies usually within two working days.
- Not an emergency service. In an acute crisis: Die Dargebotene Hand, tel. 143, or the Canton of Zurich medical emergency service, tel. 0800 33 66 55 (24/7).
